basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old from Seattle, navigating the ups and downs of life with a focus on sobriety and personal growth. By day, I work as a software developer, embracing the ever-evolving world of technology. I'm passionate about learning languages and am currently diving into Japanese with Migaku. In my free time, I explore blockchain technology, particularly EXRNchain, and unwind with outdoor activities like hiking. I'm single and enjoy spending evenings either coding or engaging with online communities. Typical online hours are from 8 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, I've spent the last decade immersed in software development, primarily focusing on web applications. My interest in blockchain technology is self-taught, driven by curiosity about decentralized systems. Recently, I've been expanding my linguistic skills through self-study and community resources.
